evidence_scope: Executable host Lua module regressions and source inspection; not an application UI, device, network-download, or rendering test.
summary: Register application/vnd.comicbook+rar and application/x-cbr as additional CBR aliases. Real registry and OPDS parser/browser tests reproduce the missing alias behavior before the fix and pass afterward, retaining both previous CBR aliases, both CBZ mappings, and deduplicated MuPDF provider selection.
attribution: The alias proposal and reported device symptom originate in upstream issue #15844. This contribution adds independent host reproduction, a focused implementation, and executable registry/OPDS regression coverage.

environment.os: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS x86_64 under WSL2 on Windows
environment.isolation: A fresh scratch directory per run, private KO_HOME, stock commonrequire, SDL dummy display/audio; frontend and plugins linked from the one existing source checkout.
environment.installed_packages_command: apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y luajit lua-busted lua-check libsdl3-0
environment.installed_packages_note: The install added these packages and dependencies without upgrading existing packages. Tests ultimately used the release-provided LuaJIT and bundled SDL3; Busted and Luacheck came from Ubuntu. No shell profiles or personal reader configuration were edited.

verification.name: red-regression
verification.source_state: 107b6ddaa7d671d10a82aee395f270608ce02720 implementation plus the new test cases, before adding either alias
verification.result: Both requested aliases fail registry recognition and OPDS suffixless-link type resolution.

verification.name: green-regression-and-existing-tests
verification.source_state: Working-tree content subsequently committed as ac9a701eb6d3e1ab5ab3e9e6681018d5a36df3da
verification.result: All four CBR aliases and both CBZ aliases resolve correctly and generate a single labeled OPDS download button; CBR/CBZ each retain one MuPDF provider at weight 100.

limitations: The evidence_type describes executable Lua module behavior only. It does not establish an Android/Kobo application runtime result, an official released-build defect, or a successful actual download/render.
The frontend/plugin/test revision is newer than the v2026.07.1 native dependency bundle. A fully revision-matched native build and ./kodev test front were not run.
The relevant existing suites were run through the published isolated Busted harness, excluding eight internet-tagged OPDS cases. The complete frontend/base suites and full project CI were not run.

The OPDS fixture exercises an Atom acquisition link with a suffixless URL. Other relations, MIME parameters/casing, OPDS 2.0, server implementations, and transport authentication were not comprehensively tested.
The new regressions do not invoke download callbacks or open an actual CBR archive. Device/UI tests require the parent investigator's explicitly selected disposable audit AVD.
The +rar spelling is a compatibility alias, not the IANA canonical media type. IANA registers application/vnd.comicbook-rar and lists application/x-cbr as a deprecated alias.
No upstream issue, pull request, comment, release, or developer message was submitted. Upstream's human-authored contribution policy must be honored before any later submission.
